thread:
Vittoria: Heads-up — Snowfall's PO keeps getting rejected by the marketplace portal. They attached the signed SOW but the portal flags metadata strictness. Error: "attachment:metadata_mismatch". Anyone seen this before?
Ben: Ugh. Is the SOW filename or content-type the problem or some missing XML metadata?
Vittoria: Portal response shows: `expected.fields=[buyer_ein,billing_entity,po_line_ids], got=[billing_entity]` — looks like it dropped the PO lines from the attachment.
Alejandro: Could be our upload wrapper stripping form-data part names. Recent change to the multipart client added `Content-Disposition` normalization.
Mike: @Alejandro can you reproduce locally against staging vendor portal? If it's the client, quick rollback might fix for Snowfall.
Alejandro: Reproducing now. If it's the normalization we can add an allowlist for `po_line_ids` and preserve part names.
Vittoria: Procurement is waiting on an exception to process manually. Snowfall is in GA pipeline; delay hits their onboarding week.
procurement-bot: Manual approval request created: PR-4532. Assigned to @Ben for exception review.
Ben: I can approve after we confirm no data loss. @Mike do we have logs showing the original multipart payload?
Mike: We keep a trimmed copy in S3. I'll pull the last failed upload and post a snippet.
Mike: snippet: ```--boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="po_lines"; filename="po.json"
Content-Type: application/json
[{"line_id":1,...}]
--boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="attachment"; filename="sow.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf
%PDF-1.4...```
Alejandro: Interesting — the vendor portal expects `po_line_ids` but we send `po_lines`. Our mapping used to translate that, but the normalization broke it.
Vittoria: Ok — what's the ETA for a fix? We need either 1) quick mapping shim in our upload client, 2) procurement manual processing for this batch, or 3) Snowfall re-submit with portal-expected field names (not great).
Alejandro: I can push a hotfix mapping shim to staging in ~90m and to prod after validation.
Ben: I'll queue the manual exception so Snowfall isn't blocked while we validate the fix. Add a note to PR-4532: manual processing for invoices 1001..1012.
Vittoria: Thanks. Also flagging product/console to add telemetry so we don't lose original part names next time. @Mike can you add an alert rule for `attachment:metadata_mismatch` spikes?
Mike: Yep — will add a high-severity alert and a nightly query to find other affected vendors.
Alejandro: Hotfix plan: mapping shim that rewrites `po_lines` -> `po_line_ids` on upload if vendor=marketplace and attachment present. Will send PR link in ~60m.
procurement-bot: PR-4532 updated with note: temporary manual processing.
Ben: Approved for manual exception. :white_check_mark: Vittoria — loop Snowfall and let them know we're on it and they'll be cleared for this batch.
Vittoria: Doing that now. Thanks y'all.
Ben: Follow-up action items: Alejandro to PR hotfix, Mike to alert, Vittoria to notify partner, Ben to confirm manual processing.
Vittoria: I'll post a short postmortem once hotfix is rolled. :memo:
